title: 第21章 可提前回归帝族参加圣战的机会第22章 另一个陈稳被替用的身份
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
对于这个便宜爷爷，他可是印象极其深刻。
霸道，强大，而且极其护短。
一人压着**天命势力，说杀就杀，那魄力，可真是举世少有。
但，对方特意找他，也不由得他不多想了。
“行了，不用折腾了，你们听老夫说几句话就行。”
这时，陈无道的声音于大堂中响起。
陈霸道立时朝虚空作了一个揖，“儿子，见过爹爹。”
陈红眠等人连忙跟着行礼，“见过爷爷。”
“嗯。”陈无道淡淡道，声音无悲无喜。
这个爷爷，原来这么高冷的？
不过，确实符合高人的逼格。
陈稳心头一动。
对自家的爷爷，又多了一个看法。
“小稳啊，这十六年来，你确实受苦了。”
说着，陈无道话锋一转，“但吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。”
这老登。
陈稳默默撤回一个感动。
“感谢啊，愣着干嘛？”陈红眠轻碰一下陈稳，低声道。
我……#%@&
心里骂咧咧的陈稳，扯着一个场面笑容道，“爷爷教导的是，孙子定谨记于心。”

“嗯，不错。”
陈无道点了点头，这才又道，“接下来我要说的是族规一事。”
“我陈族自古至今，便有一个不容改变的规矩。”
“族里的年轻一代，在成年之前，都必须下放历练，满十八岁那一天，方能回归。”
“但鉴于小稳情况特殊，还有已经在外十六年，所以特批提前回归。”
“届时，可参加族里的成年大典，以确定帝子序号。”
“补偿呢，你不会觉得事就这么算了吧。”
陈无道话声刚落，叶沉雁就立时开口道。
说着，她的话声突然提高，“别忘了，我儿子是因为家族无能，才白受了十六年的苦。”
“老爹，小稳确实是受苦了。”陈霸道深吸一口气道。
陈无道无视陈霸道的请求，而是朝叶沉雁道，“小叶啊，那你想要什么补偿？”
“直接定帝子序号，进入祖地十次，参加两次圣战的机会，还有奖励十亿神源。”
“暂时就这些，后续我想到了再跟你提。”
陈无道的嘴角直抽不止。
content_en:
He was extremely impressed by this cheap grandpa.
Domineering, powerful, and extremely defensive.
The courage of one person to suppress the forces of destiny and kill at will is truly rare in the world.
However, the other party came to him specifically, so he couldn't help but think about it.
"Okay, no need to bother, just listen to what I have to say."
At this time, Chen Wudao's voice sounded in the lobby.
Chen Badao immediately made a bow to the void, "Son, I have met daddy."
Chen Hongmian and others quickly followed suit and saluted, "I've met grandpa."
"Yeah." Chen Wudao said lightly, his voice neither sad nor happy.
This grandpa, is he so aloof?
However, it does meet the requirements of an expert.
Chen Wen's heart moved.
I have another perspective on my grandfather.
"Xiao Wen, you have indeed suffered in the past sixteen years."
As he said this, Chen Wudao changed the subject, "But only by enduring hardship can one become a master."
This is Lao Deng.
Chen Wen silently withdrew his emotion.
"Thank you, why are you standing there stunned?" Chen Hongmian touched Chen Wen lightly and whispered.
I...#%@&
Chen Wen, who was cursing in his heart, smiled and said, "Grandpa taught me that my grandson will always take it to heart."
"Yeah, not bad."
Chen Wudao nodded, and then said, "The next thing I want to talk about is the clan rules."
"Since ancient times, our Chen clan has had a rule that cannot be changed."
"The younger generation in the clan must be sent down to the countryside for training before they reach adulthood. They can only return when they turn eighteen."
"But in view of Xiaowen's special situation and the fact that he has been away for sixteen years, special approval was given to return early."
"At that time, you can participate in the clan's coming-of-age ceremony to determine the emperor's son's serial number."
"As for compensation, you don't think this is the end of it, do you?"
As soon as Chen Wudao finished speaking, Ye Chenyan immediately spoke.
As she spoke, her voice suddenly rose, "Don't forget, my son suffered sixteen years in vain because of his family's incompetence."
"Dad, Xiaowen is indeed suffering." Chen Badao took a deep breath and said.
Chen Wudao ignored Chen Badao's request and said to Ye Chenyan, "Xiaoye, what compensation do you want?"
"Determine the emperor's son's number directly, enter the ancestral land ten times, participate in two holy wars, and be rewarded with one billion divine resources."
"That's all for now. I'll mention it to you later if I think of it."
The corners of Chen Wudao's mouth twitched.
